raw_html: [[Disease: Unholy Tear]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Disease: Unholy Tear]]:''' This weapon saps the vitality from your enemies, dealing 6d6 Evil damage on each hit. It also has a chance to spread its disease whenever you strike an enemy, which will reduce their [[Armor Class]] and Positive [[Healing Amplification]].
